summary: Iteration 15 re-verification: all 9 pytest cases pass (9/9). Re-verified respond_plan frictionless flow (no-auth no-apodo yields 'Invitado 1' excluding pending invitees; participante_token in body OR x-participante-token header both rename not duplicate; authed no-apodo uses account display_name, user_id is NOT exposed in public participants JSON, plan.mine populated when fetched authed, re-respond does not duplicate). Invited pending friend answering with his account updates own row (pendiente->dentro, counts.pendiente 1->0, counts.total 0->1, 1 row only). Live Activity: POST /api/live-activity/token upserts (200+plan_id, repeat returns same plan_id, no duplicates in admin list), 401 without auth, /end returns 200. Respond/close/cancel keep returning 200 even with APNs unconfigured (APNS_TEAM_ID empty) and a Live Activity token registered. Regression: /invitables (puede_invitar=true for creator), /invite returns 403 for admin non-participant, 409 after plan closed, /admin/plans/invite-reminders triggers exactly one plan_invite_reminder notification even when called twice.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is still ~18k lines; the respond/live-activity/invite logic deserves extraction into dedicated routers (plans_router.py, live_activity_router.py).

respond_plan uses an unused expression `bool(plan.get('creador_token') and False)` (always False) for is_creator — dead code that should be removed or replaced with real detection via creator_user_id/token.

Valid intents are {'dentro','voy_si','depende','paso'}; there is no explicit 'leaving/no' intent — document this clearly in the API schema so clients don't try 'fuera'/'no'. Also surface the whitelist in the 400 error message for easier debugging.
Live Activity /token endpoint accepts arbitrary token strings; consider length/hex validation beyond non-empty to reject obviously bad APNs tokens early.
Public participant JSON correctly strips user_id for privacy, but downstream `plan.mine` relies on the client sending auth to be recognized — fine, worth documenting.

context_for_next_testing_agent: pytest file lives at /app/backend/tests/test_iteration15_respond_live.py and runs green against the preview URL. Valid plan intents are {'dentro','voy_si','depende','paso'} (NOT 'fuera'). participante_token works both in JSON body and x-participante-token header. Public GET /api/plans/{slug} intentionally strips user_id from participants; use authed GET to read plan.mine. Live Activity admin list endpoint is GET /api/admin/live-activities and returns a list (or {items/activities: [...]}) — the test handles both shapes. APNs is intentionally unconfigured in dev; _plan_push_live returns {'ok':false,'reason':'APNs no configurado ...'} and never raises.
rca of the issue: n/a — both previously reported bugs in POST /api/plans/{slug}/respond are resolved: (a) auto 'Invitado N' now counts via count_documents({intencion: {$ne: 'pendiente'}}) so pending invitees are excluded; (b) matching by participante_token (body or header) then by user_id triggers UPDATE instead of INSERT so no duplicate rows are created.
